name: Remit
summary: Approve a PKR money transfer with a one-time code: banknotes fly to the payee, then a receipt slides up
about: A transfer confirmation card in royal blue and peach that sends PKR from Bilal to Ayesha. Pick an amount (ones above your balance are crossed out), type the 6-digit code from the demo message before its two-minute ring runs out, and press Send. The button curls into a spinner, banknotes fly along a dotted arc while your balance counts down and Ayesha's ring fills, then a torn-edge receipt slides up with a reference you can copy.
how: Pick an amount; the total and the Send button update, and amounts above your balance are disabled
Type or paste the 6-digit code, or press Use code under the boxes; backspace and the arrow keys work
Press Send (or Enter) to check the code; three wrong codes stop the transfer
When the expiry ring runs out, Send a new code gives you a fresh one
Copy the receipt or press Done to make another transfer from the new balance
